question: What does the dissertation say the Mafāḥiṣ's structure is, without the three-Globes reading?
proposition: The Mafāḥiṣ is organized as an introduction of seven inquiries, three sections of inquiries on the mental (36), written (21) and spoken (18) forms of the letter, and a fourth section of 74 inquiries on the letters in themselves; no ascent-descent-ascent pattern is stated in this description.
reasoning: This is the dissertation's own plain description (pdf pp.352, 354).
It is offered as the rival to the Prologue reading, not as Melvin-Koushki's rejection of it: the dissertation does not discuss the Globes.
